title: ClinicPro
description: Manage patients, appointments, billing, and clinic financial performance in one connected platform built for healthcare practices.
meta_description: ClinicPro by OCMONO: patient records, appointments, billing, POS, and revenue insights for clinics. See features and pricing.

capabilities_json.title: Patient records
capabilities_json.description: Unlimited patient profiles with history, documents, and dashboards.

capabilities_json.title: Appointments
capabilities_json.description: Calendar views, custom timings, patient access, and WhatsApp reminders.

capabilities_json.title: Billing & invoices
capabilities_json.description: Automated billing, invoice tracking, and revenue insights.

capabilities_json.title: Web & mobile
capabilities_json.description: Access from desktop, tablet, and custom Android apps.

capabilities_json.title: Inventory & POS
capabilities_json.description: Purchase/sell tracking, cashier accounts, barcode and thermal printer support.

capabilities_json.title: Patient shop
capabilities_json.description: Optional ecommerce shop so patients can buy from your clinic online.

saas_meta_json.tagline: Complete clinic management with revenue insights
saas_meta_json.audience: Clinics, solo practitioners, and multi-location practices
saas_meta_json.problem: Clinics juggle patient records, appointments, billing, and revenue tracking across disconnected tools — losing time and visibility.

deep_features.title: Run the full clinic day in one place
deep_features.text: From registration to checkout — appointments, prescriptions, accounts, and staff roles stay connected so nothing falls through.

deep_features.title: Built for any practice model
deep_features.text: Whether you are opening a new practice, running solo, or coordinating a group — ClinicPro scales with your operations.

deep_features.title: Revenue you can see
deep_features.text: Track financial performance alongside clinical ops so owners and managers act on real numbers, not guesswork.

pricing.note: Local taxes (GST, etc.) charged in addition. Prices in ₹ / month.
